description:
A fortune in Bitcoin sits buried under a Welsh landfill. A Van Gogh portrait became chicken coop insulation. Rare baseball cards were dumped in the ocean. From misplaced diamonds to a Stradivarius cello discovered in the rubbish, these are some of the most valuable things people have ever thrown away.
